description: Use this when the user wants a saved chart to go back to an earlier version from list_chart_versions. Publishes that version's document again as a new version, keeping the chart's id and URLs, so the version it replaces stays restorable. Refuses charts with unpublished editor changes; requires authentication.

acceptLosses.description: Compatibility loss codes explicitly accepted by the user for restoring an older document

name: restore_chart_version

publishedAt.description: ISO-8601 publish timestamp, or null when public URLs are dark

sizeBytes.description: Compressed size of the stored published document, excluding drafts; 0 means no published document has been stored yet

source.description: Chart origin; an open set of string values

versionNumber.description: Number of the version the chart publishes now; list_chart_versions lists the earlier ones and restore_chart_version publishes one again

title: Restore chart version
